note: Plain line-pattern scan of Dockerfiles/compose/Kubernetes manifests, not a validating parser -- treat findings as candidates (Low/Medium confidence) to confirm, not confirmed facts. pattern_key values overlap build_graph.py's risk_patterns vocabulary where the concept matches.

findings.title: docker/Dockerfile does not declare a non-root USER
findings.description: No 'USER <non-root>' instruction found; the container likely runs as root by default, widening the blast radius of any code-execution vulnerability inside it.

findings.title: docker/Dockerfile:10 exposes port(s) 10824
findings.description: Documented for cross-reference against the architecture model's internet_exposed fields -- an EXPOSEd port is not necessarily internet-facing, that depends on orchestration/network config.
